crossRefs.note: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
“If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,
or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it
No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.
When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.
You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;
Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken?…

translations.web: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
translations.bsb: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless and take the widow’s ox in pledge.
translations.kjv: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.
translations.asv: They drive away the ass of the fatherless; They take the widow's ox for a pledge.
